title: City Cruises San Francisco: Signature Lunch Cruise
includes: Wine, Beer & Cocktails Available to Purchase on Board
Hosted Soda, Juice, Coffee and Tea
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be 21+ years old with valid identification to purchase alcoholic beverages
Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure. Guests must arrive early, as late arrivals will likely miss the boat.
policies: All enclosed areas on board are non-smoking. Smoking is only permitted outside on the outer decks.
18% gratuity will be added to additional on board purchases for parties of 6 or more.
Due to the seasonality of local fresh ingredients, all menus are subject to change.

If your cruise is in California, a service charge will be collected at the time of your reservation, related to the cruise, food, beverage and the service included in your purchase. This charge is not a gratuity and will not be distributed as a gratuity to our employees who provide service to you. If you wish to purchase additional beverages or food enhancements onboard, we recommend you leave a gratuity onboard based on the quality of service provided to you.
Seating is only guaranteed together for the number of tickets confirmed on this voucher. Reservations may not be combined.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Come aboard and indulge in a 2-hour buffet lunch cruise around the San Francisco Bay. Pass by the iconic sites like Alcatraz Island and the city skyline, and then cruise under the Golden Gate and Bay Bridge. This lunch cruise is a perfect option for touring the bay with friends, family and co-workers.
